text: Descartes' Discourse on Method was denounced by Jesuits, who officially banned it in 1663. In the same year, the censors of Rome put Descartes' works, including Discourse on Method, on the Index of Prohibited Books. French and German universities also prohibited students from reading it.
meta_description: Discourse on Method by Descartes: officially banned by Jesuits in 1663 and put on the Index of Prohibited Books that year.
